newsitem.title: USA: Conn. plans $100 mln mall in New Haven - paper.
newsitem.headline: Conn. plans $100 mln mall in New Haven - paper.

text.p: A new, $100 million shopping mall is being planned in New Haven, Conn., which is expected to create 600 construction jobs and 2,200 permanent jobs, the Hartford Courant said.

The mall, which would be built by New England Development and Fusco Corp, would link the city's green with Yale University, but the property has yet to be bought and municipal approvals have not been granted.
The center, which is expected to have 150 stores and four anchor stores, would generate $12 million in sales, property and income taxes, the paper said in its Tuesday edition.
